snippet.title: Scott Pilgrim EX - Back in the Band & Coin-Op Chaos Update Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Scott Pilgrim EX - Back in the Band DLC + Coin-Op Chaos update are out NOW! ✨

Whether you're returning to the streets or jumping in for the first time, it’s the perfect time to join the band and take on the chaos.

✨ This DLC adds 🎸 Stephen Stills, 🥁Kim Pine and 🗡️ Knives Chau as playable fighters

⚡ The free title update, Coin-Op Chaos, brings an arcade mode with lives, credits, score chasing, local rankings, co-op play, cross-platform support and drop-in or drop-out multiplayer

💥 To celebrate the release of both the DLC and the free title update, the base game is available at 20% off through September 09 - on PC and consoles, marking the first discount for Scott Pilgrim EX

It’s time to grab your crew and get ready to rock!
